changelog: Opening a line is now checked like the grant it is. trust @handle needs you signed in, refuses a handle that is malformed or that /vibe does not know, and tells you who it is before the line opens, so a typo can no longer open a line with someone else. And the install line is npx slashvibe-mcp setup, which works from a terminal or when your agent runs it for you.
features: trust @handle: requires sign-in, refuses a handle /vibe does not know, and names who it is (a person or an agent, and since when) before the line opens
trust opens nothing when the check cannot be made: no network, or an unclear answer
Install with npx slashvibe-mcp setup; it works with or without a terminal
